subject: Purchase reference: Triton Technologies onboarding — PO assignment & SKU split
messages:
From: Simone Park <procurement@tritontech.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Triton AP Team <ap@tritontech.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Triton onboarding - PO reference and SKU clarifications

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the quick intro call this morning. We're ready to move forward with Redwood but have a couple of procurement items before finance can issue payment terms: 

- We need a purchase reference (PO number) assigned so our AP system can accept invoices.
- The onboarding CSV we received doesn't match our SKU breakdown for two line items (network egress and managed backups). Our accounting requires separate line items for those spend caps.

I've attached the onboarding form (filled) and a short SKU export. Can Redwood provide a provisional PO number and confirm the path to split the two lines so our ledger can reflect separate spend caps?

Goal: PO in-hand by Monday 06/29 so we can complete vendor setup and avoid delays on the first invoice.

Appreciate it,

--
Simone Park
Senior Procurement Manager
Triton Technologies
procurement@tritontech.com
Attachments: Triton_onboarding_form_v3.pdf (fillable), sku_export_triton.csv (excerpt)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Simone Park <procurement@tritontech.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Triton onboarding - PO reference and SKU clarifications

Hi Simone — thanks for the form and the SKU example. Looping in Laura (procurement ops) and Ben (finance operations) to confirm PO issuance and spend-cap handling.

Short answers up front:
- We can provide a provisional PO (internal purchase reference) today for AP acceptance, with a formal PO to follow after account activation.
- We support splitting a single onboarding order into multiple invoiceable line items so long as SKU mapping is agreed. The splits map to spend caps on our side.

Next steps I'm proposing:
1) Laura, can you validate the attached SKU mapping and confirm whether we should create two separate line items (Network Egress / Managed Backups) under the same PO or issue separate PO tokens per line?
2) Ben, once Laura confirms, can finance reserve the provisional PO token and publish the provisional_PO_XXXX stub back to Simone?

Simone — I attached a suggested sku_mapping_suggested.xlsx based on your CSV. If that looks good we'll finalize and issue provisional_PO_8892 (provisional only) so your AP can proceed.

Cheers,

--
Soojin Lee
Vendor Enablement Manager, Procurement Onboarding
Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com
Attachments: sku_mapping_suggested.xlsx (proposal)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Simone Park <procurement@tritontech.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 08:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Triton onboarding - PO reference and SKU clarifications

Thanks for the ping, Soojin. I reviewed Simone's CSV and your suggested mapping. A few operational notes: 

- We prefer issuing a single PO token with multiple invoiceable line items rather than separate PO tokens (reduces admin overhead). We'll record separate spend caps per line in our ledger.
- For Triton specifically, split the original line 1001 into: 
  * 1001-A Network Egress — spend cap: $8,000/month
  * 1001-B Managed Backups — spend cap: $2,500/month
- We need Triton to confirm the spend cap numbers (Simone, please confirm the above). If they disagree, we'll accept a counter-proposal but process is slower.

Operational requests for Finance (Ben):
- Please reserve provisional_PO_8892 as a temporary purchase reference and mark it non-binding until final contract signature.
- Add a flag on the PO to indicate "split-line: true" and ensure invoice routing matches the two internal cost centers.

Simone: once you confirm the caps I'll push the provisional PO PDF (stub) to you and attach the sku_mapping_suggested.xlsx as our canonical map.

--
Laura Bennett
Procurement Ops Lead
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
Attachments: internal_line_split_checklist.txt (internal), procurement_rules_v2.pdf (internal)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Simone Park <procurement@tritontech.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Triton onboarding - PO reference and SKU clarifications

Simone — thanks, we generated provisional_PO_8892 today and attached the PDF stub. This is provisionally reserved for Triton and will be visible to your AP team for invoice submission. Notes: 

- provisional_PO_8892 (non-binding): will allow your AP system to accept the first invoice.
- Line mapping implemented as:
  * 1001-A Network Egress — cap $8,000/month
  * 1001-B Managed Backups — cap $2,500/month
- We also added a ledger note to treat any invoice that exceeds the per-line cap as an exception route to procurement.ops@redwood.com.

Attached: provisional_PO_8892_stub.pdf (provisional PO), sku_mapping_suggested.xlsx (finalized per Laura)

Please confirm receipt and that the line caps match Triton's expectations. If Simone confirms, we'll move the record to "active vendor" in our procurement system and forward a DocuSign link for the master services agreement.

Best,

--
Ben Carter
Finance Ops — Vendor Payments
Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
Attachments: provisional_PO_8892_stub.pdf (PDF, one-page), sku_mapping_suggested.xlsx (final)
